title: TV Explorer
summary: A TV show search and favourites app with live data and persistent collections.
purpose: Find television shows and keep a personal list of favourites.
features: Search shows using the TVMaze API
Sort saved shows and remember the theme
process: I connected an external API to a React interface, then added Firestore to keep favourites available after a refresh. This project helped me understand state, asynchronous requests, and real-time data.
learning: Instructor feedback highlighted component organization, search debouncing, and a loading state for favourites as useful next improvements.

title: Succulent Pot Shop
summary: An online shop connecting product discovery, shopping carts, orders, and inventory.
purpose: Let customers browse succulent pots and place orders, while staff manage products and order status.
features: Browse, search, filter, and paginate products
Update quantities or remove cart items
Submit checkout details and create an order
Manage inventory and order statuses through an admin session
process: I built the customer shopping flow and the administrator workflow around products, orders, and order items. Connecting order changes to stock updates helped me understand how application layers work together.
learning: Instructor feedback identified password security, CSRF protection, flexible image management, and documented test evidence as areas to improve. Payment options were coursework demonstrations rather than a production payment service.
